experiment_data.hypothesis: 14B RSFT LoRA training on CED-scored top_k=1 data (3015 samples). 14B SFT (ign_f1=0.5507) as base, expect RSFT to further improve via rejection sampling on high-quality generations. Completes scaling table 4th row (1.7B→4B→8B→14B).

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/freige && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python -m freige.training.rsft_trainer --base_model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-14B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output_14b/checkpoint-144 --rsft_data_path /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_scored_14b/rsft_train.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_14b --learning_rate 2e-5 --num_epochs 3 --per_device_batch_size 1 --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 --warmup_steps 100 --save_steps 50 --save_total_limit 2 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --lora_rank 64 --lora_alpha 128 --bf16 --wandb_project freige-rsft --wandb_run_name rsft-14b-plan017"
